item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02385","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final value 200 after correct formulas; the value increase is $600.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final difference 13 after correct formulas; the difference is 20 kilograms.","reason":"Both provide correct unevaluated formulas followed by incorrect final numbers, without showing the calculation responsible.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02386","case1_error":"Answers total beverage volume, 72 ounces, instead of the required tea ingredient amount, 9 ounces.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 240 − (80 + 120 + 10) as 50 instead of 30.","reason":"The first answers the wrong quantity; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02387","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Uses 10/10 dollars per bead instead of 1/10, producing $1800 instead of $180.","reason":"The first is an addition evaluation error; the second uses an erroneous price conversion relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02388","case1_error":"Treats 15 training days per stage as 15 weeks, omitting division by five training days per week.","case2_error":"Omits the first turn's eight spaces when calculating Susan's current position.","reason":"The first fails to convert days into weeks; the second drops an additive contribution from the cumulative position.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02389","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 35 × 0.2857 as 9.5; the exact original expression equals 10.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 12 + 15 as 33 instead of 27.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate correctly set up expressions; the different arithmetic operators do not change the mechanism.","judgment":"same"}]}
